```yaml
name: Publish Documentation

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  publish_documentation_netlify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Build documentation
        run: npm run build:docs

      - name: Deploy to Netlify
        env:
          NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN }}
          NETLIFY_SITE_ID: ${{ secrets.NETLIFY_SITE_ID }}
        run: |
          curl -X POST https://api.netlify.com/build_hooks/${{ secrets.NETLIFY_DEPLOY_HOOK }} \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '{"trigger_url": "https://github.com/dubzzz/fast-check/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}" }'
```

This workflow will now only publish documentation to Netlify when a commit is pushed to the `main` branch. It removes the need for PR previews and simplifies the deployment process using a single `curl` command. The `DRAFT_BUILD` environment variable has been removed as it was not used.
